description: Defines the SelectedCompositeDisplayField class which maps to the 'ohrm_selected_composite_display_field' database table; it models a composite display field associated with reports in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for id, compositeDisplayField, and report, along with accessor and mutator methods.

classes.name: SelectedCompositeDisplayField
classes.description: An entity class representing a record in the 'ohrm_selected_composite_display_field' table, linking a composite display field with a report.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the selected composite display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the selected composite display field.
